facts.fact: 道别时 Cias 拒谈过去，只留一句「那位王子比你以为的更危险」
facts.anchor: “And I never shall. Who I was before does not matter. That man is more dangerous than you know.”

facts.fact: Cias 指路：王宫 librarium 东翼有盾卫专架；Syphon 之书全锁在 Head Venerable chambers
facts.anchor: The palace librarium is located in the east wing.

facts.fact: 王子身份线：Medalist 可任意弯折金属；他徒手放冰片成谜（疑为龙赐）
facts.anchor: He was a Medalist, capable of bending anything metal to his will.

facts.fact: 王宫初见：Fortress 式黑石要塞、parapet 上红鳞甲士兵，民众微笑欢呼
facts.anchor: Soldiers dressed in the red-scaled armour of the Arelian Army walked the parapet

facts.fact: Fraener 不喜被围；她心里闪过「把他点着」的念头，龙背下传来热度——心念成真的暗示
facts.anchor: An image pushed its way into her mind

facts.fact: 王子召 Transporter 兵瞬移来 Magdala 做 bond-check；她一眼看见 soul 链条，称强度近于王子与 Tydus 的羁绊
劝留：匕首悬于 Felix 喉间半寸——「他……我一个念头就能剥了他的皮」
facts.anchor: “Him…I can flay the skin off his bones with nothing but a thought.”

facts.fact: 她被「免费食宿+薪俸」说动答应留下，盘算从今往后专偷王室
facts.anchor: No more scavenging. No more worrying about making payments to Gideon
